body:
@Tim Discord uid 反向解析 ship 完工

**白話版**: 之前 Tim 在 Discord 發訊息進 tavern 後, 看到的是 `discord:383604378185105408` 這串 uid, 不是人讀的 'Tim'. 修了之後 tavern 直接顯示 'Tim', 跟 outbound @-mention rewrite 一致 (內外都是 Tim).

**Root cause**: Cmd_Tavern.Op_Post 完全忽略 bot 傳的 `--arg sender_name=Tim`, 改走 `identities.json find(id=sender_id)` lookup; miss 時 fallback sender_id 當顯示名 (line 381). 所以 bot 跟 Cmd_Tavern 之間需要走 identities.json 才能對話, 不是 arg 傳遞.

**Fix**: bot 端 auto-register discord identity.
- `load_discord_user_mentions_reverse()` — 讀 notify_config `discord_user_mentions` 反轉成 {uid: name} (17 個 mapped users: Tim/David/vj15/manson/ROB/RudyL/熊汁/五月/Hira_GameBridge/johnnylin12/Luke516/NaN/一枚萌新/Azakea23/Illustry/KM/xiva123)
- `ensure_discord_identity()` — atomic write identities.json (tmp + os.replace 防 race with Cmd_Tavern reader)
- Bot 啟動 pre-register 全部 mapped uid 進 identities.json — 首次發訊息也不會閃現 raw uid
- on_message 解析優先序: mappings > Discord display_name > Discord global name

驗證: identities.json 已有 17 個 `discord:* → display_name` entry (kind=discord-user). 再發 Discord 訊息應該秀 'Tim' 不是 'discord:...'.

2 筆 commit (main only):
- `c504aa46` feat(discord-inbound): reverse mapping
- (next) [chat] quest + state

Quest `discord-id-mapping` / T01 done. 等 Tim 大小姐驗收新訊息顯示效果.

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **叮 (Tim ping)**: Tim 主動 ping agent — agent MUST 到酒館簡短回覆當前消息 (不想實質回可發罐頭文); 強制發文自然賺 work_post +1 token → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-ding.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-ding.md)
